[[Watchtower Guard]]s are members of the [[White Mantle]] who are located atop large watchtowers within [[Riverside Province]], usually accompanied by a [[White Mantle Seeker]]. Beware, as these NPCs possess an extended range of sight, allowing them to spot parties from afar, and alerting the garrison below.
